## What I found (violations of CLAUDE.md)

**Plugin manifests / marketplace**
1. `plugins/diagrams/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`: `"name": "diagram"` but the folder is `diagrams` (rule: name = folder name).
2. `plugins/diagrams` is missing from `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` (only x-assistant, avatar-video, outlook-email are listed).
3. `plugins/avatar-video/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`: no `description` key.
4. `plugins/outlook-email/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`: no `version` key.

**Frontmatter**
5. `plugins/x-assistant/skills/xhs-post/SKILL.md`: frontmatter has `name` only, no `description`.
6. `plugins/avatar-video/agents/video-scripter.md`: frontmatter has `description` only, no `name`.

**Skill created directly in `.claude/`**

That breaks the "skills live in `plugins/...`, never create one in `.claude/`" rule. I'll move it to `plugins/x-assistant/skills/quick-notes/` (existing plugin, closest theme) and link it. This placement is a judgement call — say so if you want a different/new plugin.

**Symlinks (needs a shell to verify/repair)**

9. `.claude/skills/` needs a link for every plugin skill (x-post, x-research, x-image, xhs-post, youtube-post, avatar-video, voice-video, article-explainer, outlook-email, chart-draw, quick-notes). grep can't see through symlinks, so I'll verify each with `ls -l` / a read-through-the-link test and create any that are missing.

**README**

2. Add the `diagrams` entry to `marketplace.json`.
3. Add the missing frontmatter fields (xhs-post `description`, video-scripter `name`).
4. `git mv`/move `quick-notes` into `plugins/x-assistant/skills/quick-notes/`.
5. Symlink audit: `ls -l .claude/skills .claude/agents`, replace real files/copies with proper relative symlinks, create any missing ones (including `quick-notes`).
6. Add the three missing README rows.
7. Verify: read back every changed file, confirm each `SKILL.md`/agent file starts with `name` + `description`, confirm every skill/agent has a README row, and confirm each `.claude` link resolves to its plugin source.
